# OT C04 native coordinate exports

These two unchanged coordinate files were exported during the controlled C04
precision experiment on 2026-10-21. `c04_degrees.txt` is the original
`pointings-12m (17).txt`; `c04_sexagesimal.txt` is `pointings-12m (18).txt`.
They contain three synthetic test positions, not science proposal data.
The first two positions remain distinct in Degrees but have identical exported
Sexagesimal strings. Preserve all three rows in either representation.
The files do not encode source identity, coordinate frame or authoritative array
binding. No session metadata or credentials are included.
